implement_llm_interface: implement a concrete LLM class that inherits from LLMInterface and provides generate and generate_with_context methods
generate_text_from_prompt: call the generate method on an LLMInterface subclass to produce text from a single prompt string
generate_with_conversational_context: call generate_with_context on an LLMInterface subclass passing a system message and a list of conversation messages
review_llm_interface_abstraction: review the LLMInterface abstract base class to understand the required methods for LLM provider implementations
refactor_llm_subclass: refactor an existing LLM provider subclass to conform to the LLMInterface abstract base class contract
